add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

include_directories(${VKD3D_INCLUDE_DIRS})

spec2def(ddraw.dll ddraw.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(ddraw registry ddraw_classes.idl)

# ddraw.dll is all Rust (ddraw-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(ddraw_shims OBJECT
    # clipper.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/clipper.rs)
    # ddraw.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/ddraw.rs)
    # device.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/device.rs)
    # executebuffer.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/executebuffer.rs)
    # light.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/light.rs)
    # main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/main.rs)
    # material.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/material.rs)
    # palette.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/palette.rs)
    # surface.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/surface.rs)
    # utils.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/utils.rs)
    # vertexbuffer.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/vertexbuffer.rs)
    # viewport.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ddraw-rust/src/ddraw/viewport.rs)
    rust_cohab_stub.c
    )
target_link_libraries(ddraw_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid libd3dwine libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(ddraw_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(ddraw_shims)
add_dependencies(ddraw_shims wineheaders d3d_idl_headers)
set(DDRAW_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/ddraw/ddraw_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(ddraw ddraw-cargo ddraw.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE ddraw-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ddraw_shims psdk ddraw_r ${DDRAW_REUSED} uuid_sources)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
